records.subject: You're in -- let's get Lantern Collective set up
records.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, reached first project fast (2026-07-23) but no invites and no key milestone since. Zero customer replies to three Wrenfield emails (email:65e56b37, email:91df3720, email:596748a0) and no tickets suggests low engagement; 8 days left makes unaided activation possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: One next step for Lantern Collective
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Following up on my note last week — you got a first project created, which is the main thing, since projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield and tasks live inside them.

If it's useful, the next step most teams find helpful is bringing someone else in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through getting your first tasks and your team into Wrenfield together.

Best,
Nadia
